title: Monthly spending
task: Set result to a Series of total spending (abs sum of debit amounts) per month ('YYYY-MM'), sorted by month.
hint: filter debit, groupby month, sum, abs.

title: Monthly income
context: Salary and other credits per month.
task: Set result to a Series of total credits per month ('YYYY-MM'), sorted by month.

title: Monthly net savings
task: Set result to a Series of net amount (sum of amount) per month ('YYYY-MM'), rounded to 2 dp, sorted by month.

title: Spending by category and month
task: Set result to a pivot_table: index category, columns month ('YYYY-MM'), values abs spend (debits only), aggfunc sum, fill_value 0.
hint: filter debit, add month, use abs amount, pivot.
answer:
d = transactions[transactions['type'] == 'debit'].copy()
d['month'] = d['date'].dt.strftime('%Y-%m')
d['spend'] = d['amount'].abs()
result = d.pivot_table(index='category', columns='month', values='spend', aggfunc='sum', fill_value=0)

title: Average monthly spend vs budget
task: Set result to a DataFrame indexed by category with avg_monthly (mean monthly spend, 0 dp) and monthly_budget, for the 8 budgeted categories, sorted by category.
hint: monthly spend per category, mean over months, merge budgets.
answer:
d = transactions[transactions['type'] == 'debit'].copy()
d['month'] = d['date'].dt.strftime('%Y-%m')
monthly = d.groupby(['category', 'month'])['amount'].sum().abs()
avg = monthly.groupby('category').mean().round().rename('avg_monthly')
result = budgets.set_index('category').join(avg).dropna()[['avg_monthly', 'monthly_budget']].sort_index()

title: Categories over budget on average
task: Set result to a Series of category names whose average monthly spend exceeds their monthly_budget.
answer:
d = transactions[transactions['type'] == 'debit'].copy()
d['month'] = d['date'].dt.strftime('%Y-%m')
avg = d.groupby(['category', 'month'])['amount'].sum().abs().groupby('category').mean()
m = budgets.set_index('category').join(avg.rename('avg')).dropna()
result = pd.Series(m.index[m['avg'] > m['monthly_budget']])

title: Transactions with merchant category
context: Join to the merchants table (using merchant name).
task: Set result to transactions merged with merchants on merchant, keeping tx_id, merchant, category_y renamed to merch_category — simpler: keep tx_id, merchant, and merchant_id.

title: Spend per merchant
task: Set result to a Series of total spending (abs debit sum) per merchant, sorted descending, top 10.
hint: filter debit, groupby merchant, sum, abs.

title: Amount bucket
task: Set result to a Series of counts of debit transactions per size bucket using pd.cut on abs amount with bins [0,500,2000,5000,200000] and labels ['<500','500-2k','2k-5k','5k+'].
hint: abs debit amount, pd.cut, value_counts sorted.
answer:
amt = transactions.loc[transactions['type'] == 'debit', 'amount'].abs()
b = pd.cut(amt, bins=[0, 500, 2000, 5000, 200000], labels=['<500', '500-2k', '2k-5k', '5k+'])
result = b.value_counts().sort_index()

title: Weekend spending share
task: Set result to the percentage of total spending (abs debit amount) that occurred on Sat/Sun, rounded to 1 decimal.
hint: weekend mask on debit rows; abs sums.
answer:
d = transactions[transactions['type'] == 'debit'].copy()
wk = d['date'].dt.dayofweek >= 5
result = round(float(d.loc[wk, 'amount'].abs().sum() / d['amount'].abs().sum() * 100), 1)

title: Spend per weekday
task: Set result to a Series of total spending (abs debit) per weekday name, ordered Mon..Sun.
answer:
d = transactions[transactions['type'] == 'debit'].copy()
order = ['Monday', 'Tuesday', 'Wednesday', 'Thursday', 'Friday', 'Saturday', 'Sunday']
result = d.groupby(d['date'].dt.day_name())['amount'].apply(lambda s: s.abs().sum()).reindex(order)

title: Top merchant per category
task: Set result to a Series indexed by category giving the merchant with the most total spend (abs debit) in that category.
hint: groupby category+merchant abs sum, idxmax per category.
answer:
d = transactions[transactions['type'] == 'debit'].copy()
g = d.assign(sp=d['amount'].abs()).groupby(['category', 'merchant'])['sp'].sum()
result = g.groupby(level=0).idxmax().apply(lambda t: t[1])

title: Distinct categories per account
task: Set result to a Series of the number of distinct categories per account_id.

title: Savings rate per month
task: Set result to a Series of savings rate per month ('YYYY-MM') = net amount / total credits, rounded to 3 dp, sorted by month.
hint: monthly net and monthly credits, divide.
answer:
g = transactions.assign(month=transactions['date'].dt.strftime('%Y-%m'))
net = g.groupby('month')['amount'].sum()
inc = g[g['type'] == 'credit'].groupby('month')['amount'].sum()
result = (net / inc).round(3).sort_index()

title: Discretionary vs essential
task: Set result to a Series of total spend (abs debit) split by 'Essential' (Groceries, Rent, Utilities, Health, Transport) vs 'Discretionary' (everything else).
hint: map categories to a group, groupby.
answer:
ess = {'Groceries', 'Rent', 'Utilities', 'Health', 'Transport'}
d = transactions[transactions['type'] == 'debit'].copy()
d['grp'] = np.where(d['category'].isin(ess), 'Essential', 'Discretionary')
result = d['amount'].abs().groupby(d['grp']).sum()

title: Budget utilisation %
context: Average monthly spend as % of budget.
task: Set result to a Series (indexed by category) of avg monthly spend / monthly_budget * 100, rounded to 1 dp, for budgeted categories.
answer:
d = transactions[transactions['type'] == 'debit'].copy()
d['month'] = d['date'].dt.strftime('%Y-%m')
avg = d.groupby(['category', 'month'])['amount'].sum().abs().groupby('category').mean()
m = budgets.set_index('category').join(avg.rename('avg')).dropna()
result = (m['avg'] / m['monthly_budget'] * 100).round(1)
